# Antigravity Smart Plugin Manager

> 🚀 Token-efficient on-demand plugin management for [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.dev) — automatically activates only the plugins you need, and auto-resets everything when Antigravity closes.

---

## ✨ Features

- ✅ **Lean by default** — heavy plugins (292+ skills) disabled until needed
- ✅ **Auto on-demand activation** — AI detects your task and enables the right plugin
- ✅ **Auto cleanup** — plugin auto-disables after task completes
- ✅ **Auto reset on exit** — closing Antigravity resets everything automatically
- ✅ **`plugin-manager` CLI** — manually control plugins from your terminal

---

## 📦 What's Included

```
antigravity-smart-plugin-manager/
├── install.sh                                         ← One-command installer
├── config/
│   ├── config.json                                    ← Plugin disable defaults
│   ├── AGENTS.md                                      ← Global agent rules
│   └── scripts/
│       └── plugin_manager.py                          ← CLI: plugin-manager
├── plugins/
│   └── smart-plugin-manager/
│       ├── plugin.json                                ← Antigravity plugin manifest
│       ├── skills/smart-plugin-manager/SKILL.md       ← Auto-activation skill
│       └── rules/AGENTS.md                            ← Strict lean-mode rules
└── bin/
    ├── antigravity-run                                ← Wrapper with auto-reset on exit
    └── antigravity-keepawake.py                       ← Background watchdog service
```

---

## ⚡ Install (One Command)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/antigravity-smart-plugin-manager.git
cd antigravity-smart-plugin-manager
bash install.sh
```

The installer will:
1. Auto-detect your Antigravity binary (or ask you for the path)
2. Install the `plugin-manager` CLI to `~/.local/bin/`
3. Install the `smart-plugin-manager` Antigravity plugin
4. Disable heavy plugins in `~/.gemini/config/config.json`
5. Install and start the background watchdog systemd service
6. Patch your desktop launcher for auto-cleanup on exit

---

## 🎮 Usage

### CLI (Manual)
```bash
plugin-manager list                       # Show all plugins + status
plugin-manager enable firebase            # Enable a specific plugin
plugin-manager disable firebase           # Disable a specific plugin
plugin-manager reset                      # Disable ALL heavy plugins
```

### Automatic (AI-driven)
Just talk to Antigravity normally. The agent reads the `smart-plugin-manager` skill and automatically enables/disables plugins based on your request:

| You say... | Agent does |
| :--- | :--- |
| "Firebase auth সেটআপ করো" | `enable firebase` → works → `disable firebase` |
| "BigQuery pipeline বানাও" | `enable data-agent-kit-plugin` → works → `disable` |
| "Android APK install করো" | `enable android-cli-plugin` → works → `disable` |
| "Protein sequence analyze করো" | `enable science` → works → `disable` |
| Normal Python/Git tasks | Nothing enabled — direct work |

---

## 🔌 On-Demand Plugin Reference

| Plugin | Skills | Triggers |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `firebase` | 13 | firebase, firestore, auth, cloud functions |
| `data-agent-kit-plugin` | 37 | bigquery, dbt, dataform, GCP pipeline |
| `science` | 41 | genomics, protein, pubchem, biomedical |
| `chrome-devtools-plugin` | 6 | chrome devtools, lighthouse, DOM inspector |
| `android-cli-plugin` | 3 | adb, apk, android emulator |
| `ecc-claude-code` | 292 | SDLC, architecture review, TDD workflow |
| `moneyprinterturbo` | 1 | short video, tiktok, reels, youtube shorts |

---

## 💡 How It Works

```
Antigravity starts
  └─ All heavy plugins DISABLED (lean mode: ~35 skills only)

User sends a request
  └─ Agent detects keyword (e.g. "firebase")
       └─ plugin-manager enable firebase   ← auto
       └─ Task executes with 13 skills
       └─ plugin-manager disable firebase  ← auto

User closes Antigravity
  └─ Watchdog detects exit
       └─ plugin-manager reset             ← auto
       └─ All heavy plugins back to OFF
```

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- Linux (Ubuntu/Fedora/Arch)
- Python 3.8+
- Antigravity IDE installed
- systemd (optional, for background watchdog)

---

## 📄 License

MIT License — free to use, modify, and share.
